create_VisionTransformer: create a VisionTransformer model with configurable patch size, embedding dimension, and depth for image feature extraction
build_Mlp_layer: build an MLP layer with configurable input/output features, hidden dimension, activation, and dropout rate
build_Attention_module: build a multi-head self-attention module with qkv projection, attention dropout, and optional attention map registration
build_Block_transformer: build a Vision Transformer block combining multi-head attention and MLP with layer normalization and stochastic depth
interpolate_pos_embed: interpolate position embeddings from a checkpoint to match a different number of patches using bicubic interpolation
